exclude_overhire.note: Overhire, day-call and show-by-show crew work is EXCLUDED by default — it is not a career move and it drowns the inventory. THE EXCEPTION (Michael, 2026-09-10): if the work is within `home_base.accessible_radius_miles`, it QUALIFIES and gets rowed. Reasoning: near home, show-by-show work costs no relocation, needs no notice, and is availability income Michael can actually take. Far from home the same posting is noise. Rate is NOT the test and there is no floor on this exception — Michael, on SM work, 2026-09-02: 'open to far less esp if it's nearby.' Mark these rows `level=contract` and set `accessibility=home` so they can be filtered out of career-arc reporting without being hidden from the sweep.

home_base.note: Home base, and NOT a preference — geography stays 'anywhere' and relocation stays live. This block exists only to define what 'immediately accessible' MEANS so the overhire exception and the accessibility tiers are testable rather than vibes. 90 miles is a commutable same-day round trip and it deliberately reaches Syracuse (~87mi) and Buffalo (~75mi), which are the two nearest markets with real producing houses. ⚠ Ask Michael before widening this; do not quietly grow it to make a find qualify.

highlight_tiers.note: Added 2026-09-10 by Michael's ruling. These are REPORTING tiers, not filters — nothing is excluded for lacking a tier, and a row can hold more than one. Ricky tags rows; Corso surfaces them. Purpose: remote and near-home work is immediately actionable in a way a relocation-required role is not, and the standing inventory had no way to say so.

tiers.remote: Posting explicitly states remote or fully-distributed. Never inferred from a job title — if the posting does not say it, the row does not get the tag.
tiers.hybrid: Posting explicitly states hybrid or partial-remote, with a named onsite anchor.
tiers.home: Within `home_base.accessible_radius_miles`. No relocation, no notice period.
tiers.immediate: Start date is now/ASAP/open-until-filled AND applications are accepted on a rolling basis with no deadline gate. This is about SPEED TO WORK, which is a different question from geography — keep the two tags separate and never collapse them.

highlight_tiers.reporting: The pass summary carries a ⚡ ACCESSIBLE block listing every row tagged remote / hybrid / home / immediate, sitting alongside ⚡ Spotlight. If the block is EMPTY, say so explicitly and say which sources were swept for it — an absent block and a swept-empty one are different facts, and conflating them is the single most-repeated failure in this routine.

remote_sweep.note: 🔴 The reason remote work never appears is NOT this config — `include_remote` has been true the whole time. It is that no keyword asks for it and every documented board is venue-bound. Fixing it needs SOURCES, not a flag.
lanes_where_remote_is_plausible: drafting-design — the strongest candidate by far. CAD drafting, Vectorworks/Braceworks work and rigging documentation are routinely done off-site; the Upstaging Rigging Designer find (2026-09-09) is onsite but the DISCIPLINE is remote-friendly.
creative-admin — development, grants, marketing and company administration all have real remote markets.
producing-artistic — partially; literary and programming work travels, but producing generally does not.
lanes_where_remote_is_NOT_plausible: electrician, audio-sound, stage-manager — the work is physically in the room. Do not waste sweep budget hunting remote here, and do not report its absence as a finding.
operations-safety — venue-bound by definition, though safety PLANNING and compliance documentation can be contracted remotely. Narrow exception, worth one probe.
